key_insight: Adam achieves provable geometric loss decay for sufficiently wide two-layer networks, including Poisson-equation PINNs, under explicit parameter conditions.
engineering_relevance: The results provide theoretical guidance on network width, Adam parameters, and minibatch-size effects when training PINN solvers.
method: Construct a Lyapunov function to control momentum in full-batch Adam.
Analyze minibatch Adam using exact virtual iterates, conditional dependence analysis, and second-moment concentration bounds.
Extend the guarantees to Poisson PINNs with separately sampled interior and boundary points.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence guarantees, not numerical benchmarks; minibatch loss decay holds in restricted expectation on a high-probability event.
watch_item: Guarantees require sufficiently wide two-layer networks and explicit Adam parameter conditions, so they do not automatically extend to practical deep PINNs.
paper_title: On the Global Convergence of Stochastic Adam for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
